verdict.rationale: OpenHands publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on its docs site and documents an HTTP/WebSocket Agent Server API, which suggests an API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or includes runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or try-it playground, runnable request examples, in-depth API reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
